paragraph: Laura O'Brien, a 24-year-old woman in England, had just asked for a sign when a Eurasian kingfisher streaked toward her. The small bird landed on her hand and stayed there for ten minutes. She was amazed. Later she told SWNS news that it had happened just moments after she asked.
